title: Add .gitignore and .env.example
prompt:
Create .gitignore (.venv, __pycache__, *.pyc, .env, .ruff_cache, .mypy_cache, .pytest_cache). Create .env.example with every variable from PRD §7 (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, DEBATER_MODEL, CONTROLLER_MODEL, PRO_MODEL, CON_MODEL, ROUNDS, MAX_WORDS, TURN_TIMEOUT_S, MAX_RETRIES, SEARCH_BACKEND, SEARCH_API_KEY) with safe placeholder values and comments.

Follow repo standards: TDD (write the failing test first, then code); max 150 lines per code file (split, don't compress); ruff = 0 violations + mypy clean; no hard-coded values (read from config); every external API call goes through the API gatekeeper (Epic 13); log via the LOG package; keep coverage >= 85%. Read docs/PRD.md and the relevant docs/prds/*.md before starting.
note: Expanded the minimal 0.1 .gitignore to the full set (added .env plus *.pyo, .coverage.*, htmlcov/) and added .env.example mirroring docs/PRD.md §7 verbatim — all 11 vars, one comment each, PRD defaults as SAFE placeholders (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=your-anthropic-api-key-here; optional PRO_MODEL/CON_MODEL/SEARCH_API_KEY empty). Confirmed PRD §7 = the indicative set exactly; no extra vars. TDD: wrote tests/test_env_example.py first (parses KEY=value lines, asserts every PRD §7 var present, secret keys carry placeholders not a live sk-ant- token, and .gitignore ignores .env but not .env.example) — watched 5 fail (red), then added the files (green). PRD §7 list mirrored as a maintained constant in the test for drift detection. Gates: uv sync clean; ruff check . = All checks passed; ruff format --check . = 17 files formatted (formatted the new test once); uv run mypy = no issues in 17 source files; uv run pytest --cov = 39 passed, 100% coverage (>= 85%). Skipped line-limit gate (scripts/check_line_limit.py, task 0.10 — not built yet); the new test is ~115 lines, .env.example/.gitignore are data not code, all under 150. No external API call / LOG / runtime-config usage relevant to this hygiene-only task; verified no real secret committed.
